JunsAirgapGuard.description: Checks whether a specified URL is reachable and optionally blocks execution.

url.name: Target URL
url.tooltip: Target URL to test. Only http:// and https:// are allowed.

timeout_seconds.name: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.tooltip: Timeout in seconds for the connectivity check.

mode.name: Mode
mode.tooltip: Choose whether to stop when the target is reachable, unreachable, or never stop.

probe_token.name: Probe Token
probe_token.tooltip: Change this value each run to force re-checking.
